development_case_source: configs/p2_closed_loop.v1.toml; previously used development cases, not final test
screen_stop: development_budget; task max time stays 30s; no timeout/ready claim at 5s
geometry_selection: all declared cases without infrastructure/physics/geometry error; most ready, then fewest task failures, then mean terminal (position/5mm)^2+(pi-yaw/3deg)^2; exact tie preserves declared order
planning_selection: all 3 cases x Ridge+all3 common seeds without infrastructure/physics/geometry error; most ready, then fewest task failures, then mean terminal normalized squared pose error; exact tie preserves declared order
geometry_context_commit: propose on each actual control tick from observed state and raw elapsed; commit returned context even if G action not selected; never record proposed G as applied command; holding resets via G.propose
cost: unchanged physical config; no per-model cost tuning; stage dt weighted plus terminal; action denominator physical 0.06m/s
compact_trace: every plan: input state, prior warm sequence/applied cmd, task/G contexts, RNG key/state, source/model/config hash, candidates/predictions hash, costs/counts/selected sequence; full arrays only predeclared ticks or all-invalid; raw executed physics retained for all intervals
resource_training_probe_scope: disposable common-seed11 copies only; time/backward feasibility, not P4-01 gradient correctness or S1/SK result; copies never overwrite common weights
scope: bounded development setting selection and measured resource preparation; not independent superiority, P4 learning comparison, final test or individual understanding
